title: Anyone been here?
content: Recently I was at a café and it had blue walls with clouds inside and the floors were vinyl tiles with a colorful pattern. The tables were white and the chairs were different colors. (I drew it out using Ibispaint) and I remember this carousel with spaceships? I can't remember if they were pink and orange or blue? Perhaps both?) It kinda looked like a liminal space? If anyone knows the place that I'm talking about, please let me know.
